title: Preparación del siguiente caso productivo E0
purpose: Seleccionar la siguiente publicación aprobada explícita y preparar una captura E0 dentro de la tolerancia de ±600 segundos, sin publicar ni modificar la cola.
author: Manus AI (CGO)

selection.selection_basis: Earliest future Facebook publication after the 2026-08-25T15:20:00Z selector checkpoint with explicit Meta_Post_ID, non-cancelled status and explicit experiment mapping.
selection.identity_rule: ID_Pieza remains empty because the Publication Log does not explicitly assign one; asset_ref is preserved as a reference and is not promoted to ID_Pieza.

meta_read_check.interpretation: Meta confirms the scheduled object exists and is not yet published. No E0 was captured.

e0_control.behavior: Read-only Meta check; capture E0 only if is_published=true, meta_post_id and created_time are present; otherwise return E0_PENDING without writing a snapshot. The publisher result uses the explicit IDs above, cnt empty and id_pieza empty.
e0_control.outcome: The scheduled control attempt was blocked by OAuth 2500; a later manual read obtained the published post and the hook recorded a Late non-canonical baseline. See Operations/Research/2026-08-25_Next_Productive_Case_E0_Review_Evidence.json.
